mechanism_narrative: A low federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS < 2.0%) compresses discount rates for equity valuations, generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days as market participants anticipate sustained accommodative policy.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS < 2.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained unemployment rate increase above 4.0% (UNRATE > 4.0) signals labor market deterioration, reducing consumer spending and corporate earnings growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE > 4.0, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous declines in housing starts (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate broad consumer demand weakness, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to reduced corporate revenue expectations.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both HOUST and RSAFS decline, or interaction Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A manufacturing supply shock (INDPRO growth rate < 0.5% annually) elevates input costs and reduces corporate margins, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO growth rate < 0.5%, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Sustained core inflation above 2.5% (CPIAUCSL 12-month change > 2.5%) signals impending monetary tightening, reducing equity valuations and generating negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when CPIAUCSL 12-month change > 2.5%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Strong non-farm payroll growth (PAYEMS > 150,000 jobs/month) supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days through sustained economic momentum.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS > 150,000, or Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Late-cycle economic expansion (GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0% annually) increases overvaluation risks and policy tightening expectations, causing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when GDPC1 growth rate > 2.0%, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: Joint declines in manufacturing production (INDPRO) and housing starts (HOUST) signal a broad economic slowdown, triggering negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days through reduced business investment and consumer confidence.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both INDPRO and HOUST decline, or interaction Rank IC falls below 0.03 over any 3-year window.
